assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only azur-lane:bremerton@mobile-game#azur-lane-bremerton-character-monograph, the active_provisional V1 monograph AZUR_LANE_BREMERTON_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned CN-origin Azur Lane client corpus (AzurLaneData 4cca5c24, story Lua witness d93f83db): the seven-part memory, 41 linked story records, 108 character-dialogue records, social evidence and JP/EN/TW/KR regional witnesses as the monograph summarizes them, with JP performed-voice measurements over 100 of 101 mapped WAVs. Its multilingual-speech and JP voice-performance profiles, relationship-state synthesis, adversarial and simulation audits and claim ledger are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The project's readiness grade A, score 87.75 and 'full Grade-A C1-C3 simulation' statement are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection and no audio audition.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: No story chronology. The monograph orders Bremerton by Commander relationship stage (BASELINE, AFFECTION, OATH or established intimacy) and by situation (ordinary help, hesitancy, ambiguous danger, own fatigue); its few named instances (the consultation room, one intimate skin state, 103242 theatrical performance, 103245 login) are not dated. Claims cover the corpus pinned at the commits above.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Six decision rules (ordinary help, hesitancy, ambiguous danger, deferring to an expert, own fatigue, established intimacy), a provisional social-inference loop and an asymmetry-of-care thesis give a coherent account of her helping behavior and predict two errors (overavailability, scarcity-driven pushiness followed by apology). The account does not decide between its own competing motives where they meet: whether normalizing pressure or her consent and privacy framework governs a borderline refusal is stated as a boundary ('should not be treated as mere hesitation') rather than an observed rule, and the monograph explicitly declines to choose between scarcity anxiety and jealousy for her intimate-access behavior. That is insufficiency on the deciding motive, not productive uncertainty about wording.

Three Commander stages are listed with expected behaviors, and the oath stage adds one discriminating change (bounded private priority while public sociality persists). There is no event-ordered state record and no account of change outside the Commander axis.

Semantic speech tendencies (start from shared circumstance, direct questions, specific actions, low-friction invitations, playful softening, concise warnings in danger) plus quantitative JP acoustic-state summaries (combat compression, longer pause-rich affinity speech, no monotonic intimacy-pitch law). Japanese wording is delegated to the off-row multilingual profile and no line is quoted; acoustic medians do not fix wording.

Ordinary behavior is comparatively well described: messaging and photos as relational infrastructure with selective privacy, outings, games and fandom, coaching and consultation, practical body care, and lower-effort leisure. None of it is located to records.

The Commander stages, Baltimore as familiar reciprocal calibration, and a general rule for peers and new acquaintances (reduce entry friction, introduce an expert, form a coalition) condition behavior by interlocutor. Beyond Baltimore no named peer has a modifier, and the stage descriptions are lists rather than rules that say what decides a response.

Emotional expression is modeled as permeable and integrated rather than suppressed, and her deeper helping anxiety is identified as correctness of advice. The memory set is named but not drawn on for located interior evidence, and grief or trauma are open.

Combat is functional and bounded (admits inexperience, verifies identity, flags anomalies, updates categories, warns, recommends withdrawal once objectives are met), and interpersonal conflict is limited to the pushiness-apology instance. Betrayal by a close friend is open.

Ethical content is confidentiality, permission before using case material and referral outside competence. The one stated dilemma, privacy against imminent lethal harm, is left open, and the explicit-refusal behavior is a C3 constraint rather than an observed deliberation.

Playfulness, competitiveness with Baltimore, physical affection and theatrical hero play (103242, flagged as not to be generalized to baseline) are described; the monograph warns against turning leisure into hidden therapeutic labor. No line is located.

The monograph reports a corpus scope (seven-part memory, 41 story records, 108 dialogue records) but carries almost no record-level locators, remains active_provisional on a 101/101 acoustic gate with one waveform unretrieved, and is a 394-line consolidation whose warrants live in off-row files. The corpus is Commander-heavy by the project's warning.

Affirmative limitations are recorded: overavailability and attention degradation before admission, overstepping when access feels scarce, localized physical weakness, no universal diagnostic authority, and sixteen negative constraints. Most are stated without located instances.
Specificity is by Commander stage and situation only; no period or event ordering is available in this evidence set.

conditions: Output is illustrative and labeled noncanonical, never presented as a quotation in any locale.
Commander stage, public or private setting and stakes are fixed first, as the monograph's operating order requires.
No Japanese form, honorific or catchphrase is asserted, because the multilingual profile is not in this evidence set.
scenario_readiness.note: Semantic tendencies and acoustic-state summaries constrain function and delivery direction but no wording is attested in this evidence set.

conditions: The scenario is a help, coaching, consultation, coordination or ambiguous-danger problem where Rules A, C, D or E apply.
The interlocutor is the Commander at a named stage, Baltimore, or a peer or new acquaintance handled by the general friction-reduction rule without invented history.
Explicit refusals, scarcity of access to the Commander, privacy against harm, betrayal and grief end in an open fork or abstention, not a prediction.
Output is behavioral description, not canon quotation.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: No story chronology; one named Commander stage (BASELINE, AFFECTION or OATH) or a peer context, within the corpus pinned at AzurLaneData 4cca5c24.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The Commander at a named stage; Baltimore as familiar reciprocal peer; otherwise a receptive peer or new acquaintance.
setting_constraints: Port, school-like club, consultation, leisure, social-media or sortie setting comparable to the game's
A concrete friction or task she can act on
No formal command of a large institution and no lethal-harm privacy conflict

scenario_readiness.note: The helping and coordination rules transfer to a bounded novel problem; romantic access conflicts, explicit refusal and privacy-harm dilemmas do not.

conditions: Receptive interlocutors in ordinary help, invitation, messaging, outing or game settings.
Selective privacy is preserved (confidential consultations, unposted private photos).
Hesitancy versus explicit refusal is not resolved by the model; an explicit refusal is not met with invented persistence.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary social behavior is the monograph's most developed surface, but it is unlocated and Commander-heavy.
Confidentiality and referral norms are described, but the only stated dilemma (privacy against imminent lethal harm) is open and no deliberation procedure is modeled.

conditions: The partner is the Commander at a named AFFECTION or OATH stage.
Behavior stays within the listed stage repertoire (dates, clothing evaluation, bodily care, DM anticipation, bounded private priority with public sociality kept).
Competition for the Commander's time is output as an open fork between anxiety and jealousy, with apology available; no non-Commander romance.
scenario_readiness.note: Stage-listed Commander behaviors and the oath-stage private-priority rule are supported; the motive behind access-scarcity behavior is left open.

conditions: Sortie or team task with specialists present; she verifies, warns, defers to expertise and recommends withdrawal after objectives.
Informal connector role rather than formal command; large-institution command is open.
scenario_readiness.note: Operational functioning in combat and informal coordination are described with bounded rules.

known_limits.statement: The monograph does not decide whether normalizing pressure or her consent and privacy framework governs a borderline refusal, and declines to choose between scarcity anxiety and jealousy for her intimate-access overstep.
Betrayal by a close friend, non-Commander romantic proposition, months-long grief or trauma, formal command of a large institution and privacy against imminent lethal harm are open.
The monograph stays active_provisional because one mapped waveform (103245 login) is unretrieved and the 101/101 acoustic gate is unmet; ear-dependent timbre is open.
The 103242 theatrical or hero performance amplifies activation and is not to be generalized to baseline speech.

The monograph carries almost no record-level locators, and its multilingual, relationship and validation files are not curated on this subject, so its warrants were not rechecked here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
